author: Ogrey
body:
Congratulations, Hacktivism!
He has been chosen by the Map Developer team to be the second Junior Map Developer of the Avicus Network!
A very active map maker that has shown incredible potential and a lot of dedication to map-related work.
It'll be great to work alongside you, JK.
Please welcome Hacktivism to the Map Developer Team. ;)
